# PEAK Cognitive Longevity

> Physician-led cognitive longevity program at Timarron Family Medicine in Southlake, Texas. Visits are also available by video nationwide.

PEAK Cognitive Longevity is a six-month precision medicine program led by Dr. Lori King, MD, and Dr. Chris King, MD. Both physicians lost a parent to dementia. That is why they built PEAK. The program uses advanced testing and monthly visits with the patient's own physician. It does not diagnose, treat, or cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease, and it does not promise to prevent or reverse cognitive decline.

Of the known risk factors for dementia, more than 80% are modifiable, and the Lancet Commission estimates that addressing just 14 of them could prevent or delay up to 45% of dementia cases worldwide.

## Who it is for

Adults who want to stay sharp, often before memory problems show. Many patients come after watching a parent live with dementia. A diagnosis is not required.

## Program

- Six months, with about one hour a week for modules plus one virtual physician visit each month
- Office: 200 Pecan Creek Drive, Southlake, TX 76092
- Virtual visits nationwide. Call to confirm availability in your state.
- Consultation: $350, credited toward the program if you enroll, refundable up to 48 hours before the appointment
- A spouse's consultation is free when booked back to back on the same day
- If both people enroll, each receives $500 off
- Packages: Silver $7,529, Gold $8,673, Executive $10,024. Cash or check prices are $7,239, $8,339, and $9,638
- 0% financing for qualifying applicants through Cherry, for 6 to 12 months
- HSA and FSA documentation is available. Coverage is not guaranteed.
- Supplements are not included in the program price
